answer: Copying the same citations across 163 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 163 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the trellis index resolves every citation against the nectar checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the signal audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 2567 identities would post 708 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
